title: 第九章 半年之期第十章 真正的进攻
lines: 午后的阳光懒洋洋压下来，晒得晾棚发出干燥的草木气息，混着烟叶的辛香，一阵阵往鼻子里钻。
莫奇趴在晾棚外的空地上，百无聊赖晃着尾巴，尾巴在泥地上无意识划动，画出歪歪扭扭的图形。
远处传来嬉戏打闹的声音，隐隐约约的，像是从鹰嘴崖的方向飘过来。
莫奇的耳朵动了动，立刻站起来，伸着脖子朝那边打量。
什么都没看见。
他收回目光，在地上滚了个身，仰躺着看了一会天，又翻过来趴着，顺手揪一把旁边的野草，捏在爪子里搓来搓去，心里跟猫挠似的，浑身都不自在。
“难受啊。”
莫奇往胸口挠了两下，重重的叹了口气。
当初他嘴馋好奇，小心翼翼从灰矮人的晾棚抓了几捆烟叶，本以为神不知鬼不觉，谁知转眼就被喂哺者发现了，把他绑在岩壁上吊起来打。
挨打也就算了，结果喂哺者还下了命令，说以后每日灰矮人外出下矿的时候，莫奇就要在晾棚旁边看守，如果烟叶再出现损失，一概全部算到他的头上。
莫奇满心不愿，却也不敢违抗喂哺者的命令，只能每天在晾棚附近呆着。
这样一趴，转眼就是大半年。
最开始那些讨厌的雏龙知道这事，没少跑来这里嘲笑他，还有许多偷偷摸摸、想要捣乱把烟叶盗走的，弄得莫奇手忙脚乱，不过后来时间久了，大家习以为常，渐渐也懒得再来，日子终于变得清净下去。
其实他倒不觉得待在这里有多羞耻，也不记恨那些捣乱的家伙，只是这样日复一日的看守，实在很消磨龙的耐心，非常无聊，搞得莫奇每天都心烦意乱、郁闷非常。
他还想像之前那样，漫山遍野的玩，尤其想去参加竞驰赛。
自从西隆退赛之后，之前那种一家独大、毫无悬念的局面再也不存在了，鹰嘴崖上反倒变得更加热闹，竞争也愈发激烈，越来越有意思。
接近一岁的雏龙们，纷纷开始显现自己的特长，凭借铬龙独特的精密灵巧，莫奇逐渐开始获得比赛上的领先，更是拿到了几次第一，这种成就感让他心里热情更大。
后来鹰嘴崖上的小龙们凑在一起，学那些铁龙搞战力排名的方法，又搞出一份竞驰赛排名来。
莫奇心里清楚，赭石谷里的战力排名轮不到他，可是竞驰赛排名，自己却很有机会去争一争，要是能拿下十次第一，就可以把名字刻在鹰嘴崖起点的大石板上，想想还是蛮威风的。
要是成功，他接下来还可以把西隆邀请出来挑战。
西隆已经半年没有参赛了，虽然是鹰嘴崖的传说，但也势必生疏，到时候他们齐头并进、势均力敌，最后自己凭借对山道惊人的理解，以毫秒之差拿下胜利……哈哈，哈哈。
这样想着，莫奇忍不住开始得意起来。
想起西隆，他们都姓索拉克斯，流着一模一样的血，可西隆的天赋明显更高，自破壳后就表现出明显的与众不同，不仅爪牙锋利、发育更快，还异常的聪明刻苦，每日训练不辍，近来实力更是突飞猛进，只凭单爪就可以把自己挂在悬崖上，看得莫奇目瞪口呆。
不过这半年来，西隆好像尤其忙碌，莫奇每次去找他玩，他都说没有时间，亦或是说想要休息。
莫奇没了玩伴，当然不开心，于是有空了就跟在西隆后面，看看他到底在干什么。
结果发现这家伙不仅每天都去攀岩，还要跑到湾湖，在那边曳游潜水，拿膜翼拍击水流，又去铁木林里踩绳索，摇摇晃晃站在上面行走。
乖乖隆滴咚，别说上去体验，莫奇仅仅是看着，都觉得眼睛干涩、浑身疲惫。
说起铁木林踩绳索，还有件额外的插曲。
那条绳索，原本只是矮人们用来快速传递物资的滑绳，半年前莫奇和西隆一起发现的，西隆小心翼翼站上去试了试，说感觉还算牢固，可以承受雏龙的重量，便准备将其加入自己的训练计划。
结果当西隆真正踩上去，仅仅只是为了维持平衡，在滑绳用力挣扎几下，滑绳便立刻崩断，连带着两端的木桩、窄桥一同坍塌，土崩瓦解，尽数坠入下方的河溪之中。
大祸临头。
破坏桥梁的事情被喂哺者知道，西隆当然少不了挨一顿毒打，莫奇在旁边，也被训得不敢出声。
可过几天他们再去看的时候，发现灰矮人们已经修好了木桩，把需要两人合抱的铁叶木深深凿进大地里，原本细小脆弱的麻绳，也被换成了油光瓦亮的筋索。
那是用来制作床驽和投石车的军械物资，异常坚韧，除非有人使用利刃蓄意切割，否则绝难损坏。
因为遍布雏龙的缘故，山谷里的金属制品基本都被妥善收纳起来，筋索虽然不是铁索，却远比铁索要贵重许多。
从此西隆的生活便变得愈发规律，力量明显越来越强，个头也越来越大。
现在莫奇走出去，那些雏龙都不喊他的名字，反倒说他是西隆的兄弟，也有直接说他是西隆弟弟的。
其实莫奇破壳的时间，比西隆还更早一些，但现在他们两个站在一起，任谁也不会说鳞片灰扑扑、体型小一号的莫奇是为兄长，不仅如此，恐怕还要严重怀疑一下他们的血缘关系。
有这样一个兄弟，对莫奇来说，真是……
太好了！
他一点嫉妒的感觉都没有，反倒觉得美滋滋，巴不得西隆越变越强，最好能一巴掌拍翻什么希多里维、杰利里昂，最后去挑战那个血脉强到离谱的怪物。
如果成功，莫奇到时候也能扬眉吐气，昂头挺胸从那些铁龙面前走过，以后只要碰到，都斜着眼睛看它们！
就是最近有条鸣雷龙，不知怎的一直跟在西隆后面，西隆做什么，鸣雷龙也做什么，好像要把他的兄弟抢走似的，想到这里，莫奇心里又有些不太高兴。
时间一点点过去，光线的角度渐渐变了，晾棚的草顶投下长长的阴影，斜斜铺在红土地上，矿坑那边陆续传来脚步声和人声，灰矮人们下工了，三三两两从山路走下来。
莫奇立刻结束胡思乱想，抬头看了看天色，感觉离晚饭还有一段时间，可以去竞驰赛里玩上几轮。
content_en:
The afternoon sun lazily pressed down, causing the drying shed to emit the smell of dry vegetation, mixed with the spicy aroma of tobacco leaves, entering the nose in waves.
Mochi was lying on the open space outside the drying shed, wagging his tail out of boredom. His tail unconsciously padded on the dirt, drawing crooked shapes.
There were sounds of play and play in the distance, faintly, as if coming from the direction of Eagle Beak Cliff.
Moqi's ears twitched, and he immediately stood up, stretching his neck and looking over there.
Nothing was seen.
He withdrew his gaze, rolled over on the ground, lay on his back and stared at the sky for a while, then turned over and lay on his stomach. He grabbed a handful of weeds nearby, pinched them in his paws and rubbed them, feeling as if a cat was scratching him, and felt uncomfortable all over.
"It's uncomfortable."
Mo Qi scratched his chest twice and sighed heavily.
At first he was greedy and curious, so he carefully grabbed a few bundles of tobacco leaves from the gray dwarf's drying shed. He thought he was unnoticed, but in a blink of an eye he was discovered by the feeders, who tied him to the rock wall, hung him up and beat him.
It was okay to be beaten, but in the end the feeder gave an order, saying that from now on when the gray dwarves go out to mine, Moqi would be guarding the drying shed. If the tobacco leaves were lost again, it would all be blamed on him.
Mo Qi was unwilling but did not dare to disobey the feeder's order, so he could only stay near the drying shed every day.
After lying down like this, half a year passed in the blink of an eye.
At first, those annoying young dragons knew about this and came here to laugh at him. There were also many sneaky ones who wanted to cause trouble and steal the tobacco leaves, which made Mo Qi busy. However, as time went by, everyone got used to it and gradually became too lazy to come again, and the days finally became peaceful.
In fact, he didn't feel ashamed to stay here, and he didn't hold grudges against the troublemakers. It was just that guarding him day after day really wore down Long's patience and was very boring, making Mo Qi very upset and depressed every day.
He also wanted to play all over the mountains and plains like he did before, and especially wanted to participate in galloping races.
Since Shillong withdrew from the competition, the previous situation where one family was the only one and there was no suspense no longer exists. On the contrary, Eagle Beak Cliff has become more lively, the competition has become more intense and interesting.
The young dragons, who were nearly one year old, began to show their own specialties. With the unique precision and dexterity of the chromium dragon, Moqi gradually began to take the lead in the competition, and even won the first place several times. This sense of accomplishment made him even more enthusiastic.
Later, the little dragons on Eagle Beak Cliff got together, learned the methods of the iron dragons to rank their combat power, and came up with a racing ranking.
Mo Qi knew in his heart that he would not be able to compete in the battle rankings in the Ocher Valley, but he had a good chance to compete in the racing rankings. If he could win ten times, he could have his name engraved on the big stone slab at the starting point of Yingzui Cliff. It was quite impressive when he thought about it.
If he succeeds, he can also invite Shillong to challenge.
Shillong has not participated in the competition for half a year. Although he is a legend of Yingzuo Cliff, he is bound to be unfamiliar. When the time comes, they will go hand in hand and be evenly matched. In the end, with his amazing understanding of the mountain road, he won with a millisecond difference... Haha, haha.
Thinking like this, Mo Qi couldn't help but start to feel proud.
Thinking of Shillong, they were all named Thorax and had the same blood, but Shillong's talent was obviously higher. He showed obvious differences after breaking out of his shell. Not only were his claws sharp and developed faster, he was also extremely smart and hardworking. He trained constantly every day. Recently, his strength had improved by leaps and bounds. He could hang himself on a cliff with just one claw, which made Mochi stunned.
However, Shillong seemed to be particularly busy in the past six months. Every time Moqi went to play with him, he said he didn't have time, or that he wanted to rest.
Of course Mochi was unhappy without a playmate, so he followed Shillong when he had time to see what he was doing.
It turned out that this guy not only went rock climbing every day, but also went to Bay Lake, where he swam and dived, slapped the water with a membrane wing, and stepped on ropes in the ironwood forest, standing and walking precariously on it.
Guaiguai Long Didong, let alone experience it, Mo Qi felt his eyes were dry and his whole body was tired just by looking at it.
Speaking of Tiemulin stepping on the rope, there is an additional episode.
That rope was originally just a sliding rope used by dwarves to quickly transfer supplies. Moqi and Shillong discovered it together half a year ago. Shillong carefully stood on it and tried it. He said it felt solid and could bear the weight of the young dragon, so he was going to add it to his training plan.
As a result, when Shillong really stepped on it, just to maintain balance, after struggling a few times with the slide rope, the slide rope immediately collapsed, and the wooden piles and narrow bridges at both ends collapsed together, and they all fell into the river below.
Disaster is coming.
The destruction of the bridge was known to the feeders, so of course Shillong received a severe beating. Mochi was by his side and was also trained not to speak out.
But when they went to see it a few days later, they found that the gray dwarves had repaired the wooden stakes and dug the iron leaf wood that required two people to hold it deeply into the earth. The originally small and fragile hemp ropes had also been replaced by shiny sinews.
It was an ordnance material used to make bed slaves and catapults. It was extremely tough and would never be damaged unless someone deliberately cut it with a sharp blade.
Because there are so many young dragons all over, the metal products in the valley are basically stored properly. Although the sinew ropes are not iron ropes, they are much more valuable than the iron ropes.
From then on, Shillong's life became more regular, and he became noticeably stronger and bigger.
Now when Mo Qi went out, the young dragons did not call him by his name. Instead, they said that he was Shillong's brother, and some directly said that he was Shillong's younger brother.
In fact, Mochi broke out of his shell earlier than Shillong, but now that the two of them are standing together, no one will say that Mochi, with gray scales and a smaller body, is the elder brother. Not only that, but their blood relationship may also be seriously doubted.
Having such a brother, for Mo Qi, is really...
Great!
He didn't feel jealous at all. Instead, he felt pleased with himself. He hoped that Shillong would become stronger and stronger. It would be best if he could slap down Hedorivi and Jellion with one slap, and finally challenge that monster with ridiculously strong blood.
If he succeeds, Mo Qi will be able to walk past those iron dragons with his head held high and his chest held high. Whenever he encounters them in the future, he will squint at them!
There was a Thunder Dragon recently, and for some reason it kept following Shillong. Whatever Shillong did, the Thunder Dragon did as well, as if it wanted to snatch his brother away. Thinking of this, Mo Qi felt a little unhappy.
Time passed little by little, and the angle of the light gradually changed. The grass roof of the drying shed cast a long shadow, spreading diagonally on the red soil. Footsteps and human voices were heard from the other side of the mine. The gray dwarves left work and walked down the mountain road in twos and threes.
Mo Qi immediately stopped thinking and looked up at the sky. He felt that there was still some time before dinner and he could go and play a few rounds in the racing competition.
title_en: Chapter 9: Half a Year Chapter 10: The Real Attack
